tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// dzo ki badz+ra nā tha'i gdams ngag chig brgyud ma bi dza hā ram/ 1$0000250brgyud pa dang po/1$0000300

oṃ gho ra ṣa nā ri/ pī a i pā ni/ shī wa pā gha ti/ dzha pa yi ā ni/ thā wa i/ pā ye pā/ pī a i pā ni/ tī ni bhu wa na/ ā tsad bha wa/ hā ri dzha gha tra/ ma hi mau paṇ+ḍi bha ti/ lo hu mo kā ya/ badz+ra ma yi/ pā ni ā nan+ta/ shi dha ko ṭi/ pi a i dzha ṇi/ thā ba yi bha ye sa/ pī a i pā ni/ tī ni bhu wa na/ a tsad bha wa/ u la ṭ+ṇ+thi/ ro i na pā la ṭa i/ kā ya phi ri/ hā ra sa ma ya/ nā tha badz+ra nā ma he sa badz+ra/ dzu gha hūm̐ dzu gha ha ri dzha gha tra/ mau paṇ+ḍi bā ri/ sngags 'di gnyis nyi ma 'char kha'i 'od dmar po yal tsam na chu thigs pa gcig lag mthil du blugs pa la lan gsum btab nas 'thung na tshe ring bsod nams che'o// bhau mi ṭho ki /pār yi sā ra/ gu ru u pa de sha /e ka yi shi bhis/ u pa e shi /tshā ti shi /bhi shi /bha kha rong*/ ghau tsa rā/ bhā ṇi na hing*/ bhis/ mau dhe ṣe/ pā la bha li/ ri bhi shi /sngags 'di lan gcig bzlas la cog tse'am/ sder gdan byung dus sa la rol mo'i sgra 'byin/ ha the le/ dhī ṭhen/ bhā ra/ pā hi na/ bha na/ ṭhak+ku rā i ni/ dz+nyā na e ka i shi /bhi shi /u pa i shi /tshā de shi /bhi shi /bha kha rong*/ ghau tsa rā ghā ni/ na hi bhi shi /mau rdo sha ṇa/ sa rā/ bha li ri bhi shi /de nas sngags 'di gsum bzlas/ zas blangs la srin lag la btab/ bza' btung gang byed la reg cing mig gis cher gyis bltas/ des ni bhi sha'i gnod pa thams cad bsrung bar 'gyur ro// ā nan+ta/ mo ru bhi/ bhai ra wa/ tshū ri tsa na dhi/ ka ra dha ṇa ṭo/ bhi ka rā ra/ e ka hā tha/ ḍa ma ru/ dhū dzhe hā tha/ su na hā/ bhā ha na ti dze/ na then ṣa sa ra/ tsa u then/ hā then/ ka dhi/ lai kha sa ra/ ghi ri dha/ mang pā na/ dha kha yi/ dzha tā mā ra ya/ ta ta/ rak+ta so khā hi/ gha hū bha ṣe ṇi/ kā pū ta/ mo gha ha la/ ki tsam/ sar+gha mi tu/ sa tā la/ tī ni bhu ba na/ me re sa tu ti ra/ a ta hā ra/ dhā ra ti sa dhe/

dzha ta bha ṭa/ bhai ghe dhu ru ta dzī hū ma ra/ dha hi ni/ tshau ri bhā mo ṭha/ ḍha be ra dzha pā ma/ a hi ni sa/ bhai ra wa/ ghā ya sa mu tra/ pā la tsā la ha/ mā tshā ri/ te a dha a/ ghā ra ma ra hā/ sar ta i k+ṣa/ le bhu dza/ sngags 'di gza' mig dmar byung ba'i nyi ma dang po dang rjes ma gnyis la dgu brgya re bzlas shing*/ bar pa drug la sum brgya re nyal khar bzla zhing*/ phreng ba la mdud pa bor ba man ngag ltar byas la sngas su gzhug /tha ma dgong mor sngags bzla/ ril me'i nang du nye'u chung gi sha'i mjug ma nas bcad de/ de'i dum bu dang spos dkar bsreg pa'i dud pa bya zhing*/ chang phud kyang thab kyi nang du dor/ drag sngags zlog pa'i mchog go /oṃ sar tha ma/ de ba ka ra ṇa/ bhu ti e pā na/ bā pa ka na/ tre te tre lo ka lo ka tsa u ka tsa tur+the/ bhañtsa me/ phā na phā se ka ra/ pa ha sra ka ra ṇa/ ṣaṣ+ṭa me sap+ta me/ ā ra wi nā ma/ a dhi ra ta nā ma/ aṣ+ṭa me/ ṇa me mā ra kaṇ+ḍe u/ ra ṣu nā ma/ dha sa me/ e ka dha shi ang*/ shrī wa su t+ya di na/ ka ra nā ma/ dhe dha shi /u dha hang*/ ā dhi dha/ mrid thā ne/ shi wa/ ling ga /shañtsa bi ṇaṃ rū pa/ dhiṣ+ṭa muṣ+ṭi kuṣ+ṭi pā sa/ ṣaṇ+ḍa ṇ+ṭhi/ shrī wa su t+ya/ de wa na mo na mo/ u ka waṇ+ṭhi/ su ra dha ra dha ranaṭha/ rā dza pri dza/ mai ra mu kha tso wān+ta/ a hi ka raṃ me tai ri/ shre wa rā dza pra dzaḥ mai ra bha shi /mai re ba ga /ta ra ā ni/ dhi u/ ā wa yi/ na hiṃ ar+tha/ ut+tha/ ka pā ṭa/ phā ṭa yi/ shri wa su t+ya de wa/ ā ghi ya/ phu re/ sngags 'di gza' nyi ma'i sgo nas yin/ sngags gong ma tshar gcig dang*/ 'og ma tshar gnyis nyi ma bye ba tsam shar ba la 'don/ dbang sdud kyi mchog yin no// oṃ na mo/ bhiṣ+ṇa pañtsa ra/ ma hā de wa/ sarba duṣ+ṭa/ li kaṇ+ḍa na/ ki ti su ra na/ dha yi dha ma ṇa ṇa dho/ ī sha raṃ/ bha ha ma/ dzha sa ta/ to haṃ pa/ sa ra ma/ ak+ṣa mi/ ā ta mā/ rak+ṣa yi pa tā ma hi/ sa dhi/ gho bhan dha ra shīn dhi/

dzi gha tsa yi wa/ bhi kra ma sa ti/ upho/ ra ṇa kaṇ+ṭh-i/ ke se wa/ gu h+ya dha na ta/ bha ma ba ti/ ru ti ra na/ sa tu ma lā ba/ tsa yi wa/ puṣ+ṭe/ ha ri ha ra/ dhir dha ya/ dza nā dza na/ kaṭa ṭhe/ pa sa ti/ na rā yen/ mu ṣa maṇ+ḍa la/ mā dha wa/ kra ṇa su trai ṣu/ nā shi kā kai shatha wa/ puṣ+ṭi rak+ṣa/ nai tre/ nā rā he na/ li lāṭa/ gha ru ra dhu tsa/ ka pā la/ kai sha wa/ aṣ+ṭhān/ bhā yi bhin tra/ pra ta wa/ su tsad/ gha tsā tha raṃ/ ku wai ra/ tsa yi wa/ aṣ+ṭa ta thā/ tung gha raṃ/ dza lai/ ā ma/ u ma/ rak+ṣa ye/ ā kā sa/ rak+kha shrī wa/ dha ri sha ṇaṃ/ she nan/ thu rak+kha/ sar+pa/ gha trai ṣu/ sra ra dh+riṣ+ṭa bhaṣ+ṇa pañtsa ra/ rā dza āḥne/ sa sā ye/ su ro/ ma hi bha wang*/ dhṛ ki ni/ saṃ ki ni/ tsa yi wa/ bhū ta pre ta/ bhi nā sa naṃ/ dhi na rā ṣaṇ+ṭhi su t+ya/ rā ti rā kha ye/ tsan dra ma/ tra sa nā ra ra shrīrba/ rak+kha/ dza la bhiṣ+ṇa/ tha la bhiṣ+ṇa/ dza la ma la/ ku le bhiṣ+ṇa/ sarba bhiṣ+ṇa/ na mo na mo/ sngags 'di nyi shar tshar gcig nub mo nyal khar tshar gcig brjod na/ byad dang lha 'dre'i gnod pa bsrung ba'i mchog go /gdams pa 'di grub chen dzā ྷbīr gyi thugs nyams su bzhes pas 'ja' lus mngon du gyur/ des badz+ra nā tha la gnang*/ rlung sems la dbang thob/ des sprul sku rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal po la gnang/ thugs nyams su bstar bas sku'i bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ de nas rim par brgyud do// mtshon srung ྈྈྈྈྈྈ (shar) oṃ surba mu khe/ dhe ya pā'o/ pū ru tsa lā ya/ badz+ra ka gā ra/ pā ta/ rā khu mau gha ha ṭa/ mau dhe bhā tra/ ma yin/ dzā yi bha/ dharma pā/ ta ha ṇa ho'i/ kā ya bhi nā sa/ rak+ṣa/ ka re ā dhi mi na/ tsa'u rang gi shrī ghor ṣa nā tha/ (lho) dhak+ṣi ṇa mu ṣe ṇa/ di ya pā'o/ ṇa mā ṇa/ dzai ki ni/ lā ya/ badz+ra ka wa ra/ sa ta rā ṣu/ mau gā ha ṭa/ mau dhe bha tra/ ma yin/ dzā yi pā/ dharma pā sa/ dha hā na ho'i/ kā ya bhi nā sa rak+ṣa ka re/ ā dhi me na/ tsa'u rang gi shrī ghor ṣa nā tha/

(nub) bha tsha ma/ mu ṣe ṇa/ de ya pā'u/ so sa nā tha/ lā ya/ badz+ra ka wā ra sa ta/ ra ṣū/ mau gha ta/ mau dha bhe dra/ ma yin dza yi bha/ dharmā pā sa/ ta haṃ na ho'i/ kā ya bhi nā sa rak+ṣa ka ra ye/ ā dhi me na/ tsa'u rang gi shrī ghor ṣa nā tha/ (byang) ut+tar mu ṣa di ya pā 'u/ ghang ga bha hī ni/ lā ya/ badz+ra ka wā ra/ gha ga bha hī ni/ ut+tar/ rā dza sa ta ra ṣū/ mau gha ha ta/ mau dhe bha dra/ ma hin dza yi sa/ dharmā bhā sa/ dha hang na ho'i/ kā ya bhi nā sa/ rak+ṣa ka ra ye ā+e di me na/ tsa'u rang gi shrī ghor ṣa nā tha/ ('og) pā tā la/ mu ṣen di ya pā hu/ bha su ki lā yā/ badz+ra ka wā ra/ ba su ki/ sa tā ya/ rā dza/ sa ta rā ṣu/ mau gha ha ṭa/ mau dhe bha dra/ ma yin dzā yi sa/ dharma pā sa/ dha hang na ho/ yi kā a bhi nā sa/ rak+ṣa ka ra ye/ ā di me na/ tsa'u rang gi shrī ghor ṣa nā tha/ (steng) ā ka sa/ mu ṣe na/ di ya sā hu/ a kā sa ka mi ni lā ya/ badz+ra ka wā ra/ a kā sa ka mi ni/ a kā sa ra rā dza/ sa ta ra ṣu/ mau gha ha ṭa/ mau dhe bha dra/ ma yin dzā yi pa/ dharma pā sa/ dha hang na ho'i/ kā ya/ bhi na sa rak+ṣa kā ra ye/ a dī mai na/ tsa'u rang gi shrī gho ṣa nā tha/ 'di rnams bris la bsrung ba bya/ mtshon thub/ yang*/ ('og) a kā sa/ bhai ra wa/ pa tā la/ bhai ra wa/ dzha ha de ṣa 'uṃ/ taṃ ha ā thi dza ha na de ṣa 'uṃ/ rā hā nā hī/ pa tā la dz+wa yi/ pa tā la a nā hi/ ā ka sa dz+wa yi le'i/ māṃ sa na pā ra yai/ bha su/ bhā ri/ dhaṃ ki ni/ kan dha ko dha/ ri ye ka li/ shi la/ ma ḍa la dha ra/ bhan dhi/ ghā i pā ra re shi /e pā ta ṣa kā hi/ lā gha/ a dha ha ra dzha ra yi/ badz+ra phu ra yi/ a dhi mi na/ tsa'u rang gi shrī ghor ṣa nā tha/ rak+ṣa ka re/ lan gsum/ ྈ rgya gram sa la rdeg /lag len zhal las dris/ e sar/ ka hi ho ta/ ṇi bā la ka dzha ra/ kau le ā ya/ kaṇa ḍe ra la ā ya/ o ha ra/ dza ri ya/ kaṇa ṭha rad/ ma ri hi ya/ kau yi tī ra/ bhā me ko yi tī ra/

dhi hi ni/ so ye/ tri ra a thā bhe tsā le/ ta ṣū bhi ra/ ha ṇi mān+ta/ ti ri sa ka ti/ mau ti/ bha ga i pa rau/ bha tsang*/ sa spang re mda' re brje ba zhal las shes par bya'o// ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ༈ (ja) rkang pa'i nywa bla rmen/ nu ma/ mchan khung*/ mig rma/ mchil ma ser kha rnams la lci ba/ thal ba/ bhi ka bha ka /hū li bhar bhar/ hūm̐ li/ khā na tha la li/ ka ba bhi la yi/ ā ṣi/ rā ma ṇa/ mā ra ye/ mai ḍā ki ha ṇi mān+ta/ rā ṣa ye/ gha ha sa ka ye na/ ya ṇa bī ra ṇa/ hi ka ye/ shṛ ha ṇi mān+ta/ a ghi'ang*/ pho ra he/ a ki ni dza ra hi/ sa ra dza ra hi/ dza ra hi/ kaṇ+ṭha bha ha ra/ rā yi te la na dzi/ lā wa yi sa hi/ phā ra/ ā dzī ta/ pū ta saṅku ra/ kya ka ra yi/ bha shan ra/ de rā ṣa he/ so dza dzhā ra yi bā su/ tsaṇ+ḍi dho sa ka ti/ i ṇa ṇi/ tau shaṃ dhi/ gu ru ka pā dzā na/ yi sa ro/ bā dza/ o ga nad la thal ba/ snum bkol tsha na hi/ zhal las dris/ ༈ mdze nad pho nad bcos thabs koṣ+ṭi na hi bar byed pa'i u pa de sha'o// oṃ pra tha ma/ dhe wa ka ra/ dhā ti e bhā ṇa bhā sa ka ra/ tri te e tra lo ka tsa'u ka /tsa tu ra ṭhe/ pañtsa me/ pra bhā pa ka rang*/ sa ha sra kor+ṇa/ ṣaṣ+ṭa me sa sa te ma/ ra wi ṇa ma/ a dhi ta nā ma/ aṭ+ṭa me/ na mo mā ra ka ḍā+e u/ ra ghu nā ma dha sa me/ e ka dha sha /shi wa s+s+dzu nā ma/ dzhi na ka ra nā ma/ dho a dha/ sa nā ma/ u dha ya/ a dhi ta/ ma dha ṇe/ shi wa lika saṃ dza/ bhiṣ+ṇa ru pa dhiṣ+ṭa muṣ+ṭi kuṣ+ṭi/ sa bha ṣa ḍaṃ thi i sa ra na tsa/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di dag par bzlas shing*/ chu gtsang ma la sngags lan gsum gdab/ de 'thungs nas yang snga ma bzhin du chu la lan gsum gsum gdab cing*/ sngags 'di dgu bzla/ chu 'di lan gsum 'thung bas phan par the tshom med do// 'dis ni koṣ+ṭi la sogs pa nad gsum la phan pa yin no// dus gnad ni nyi zer dmar 'od yal nas/ dkar po lta bu snying po phyed tsam shar nas yod pa'i dus su'o// / nad tshabs che na lo gcig dang*// 'go zin tsam la zla drug gis// nges par sel 'gyur the tshom med// 'dzem bya sha chang bud med dang*// zho dang 'o ma spang bar bya// lan tshwa cung zad ran pa yis// ja dang skyo tsha mdzo mo'i mar// skya bor la sogs dkyus su brten// mi khyi'i sgra yis dben pa'i sar// lus ngag yid gsum dge sbyor dang*// man ngag 'di nyid nyin re bzhin// bar ma chad par brten gyur na// sna zhom pa yang sos mod kyi// 'go zin rnams la smos ci dgos// 'di 'dra'i man ngag khyad 'phags 'di// sngon chad bod 'dir byung ba med// rgya gar dzo ki'i man ngag go

/maṅga laṃ//1$0000250 ༈ dzo ki badz+ra nā tha'i man+t+ra/ (ka) 1$0000300༄༅// na mo shrī ghor+ṣa nā tha/ grub chen dzhābīr gyi gdams pa skran bcos pa'i thabs la/ nad pa'i mdun du sa la 'jag mas sngags mkhan gyi sor brgyad yod pa'i ri mo 'di ltar bri/ ྈ sngags ni/ ā shi sa ha sra/ bh+ra ma tsa le/ shā+o la sa ha sra/ sang kro na/ ṣa tsa ka /a ru ru/ bhi ṣa de wa kā ra/ a dza na dhe/ rā ṇi bhi khū ki /a pā ni/ ha ro ha rā+e/ dza tā dza rā+e/ dzha 'ag ma 'u 'ad/ bhi shū li ā/ tshin+na shrī ghor+ṣa ti di/ ang 'gre phu re/ zhes tshar re bzlas shing*/ nad pa'i skran gzhar te sa la phab tshul bya/ de nas sor la tshad pas ring du 'gro bas gang song gcad de dor/ yang snga ma ltar/ nangs gung dgong gsum gyi dus tshar ma phan par bya/ 'dis skran gyi rigs thams cad 'joms te gtar kha sogs mi dgos/ skran ro gting phyin par song na rjes gcod me btsa' sogs kyang mi dgos/ zhes gu ru dzā ྷbīr gyi dngos slob dzo ki de wa nā thas gsung zhing*/ bdag gis kyang myong bas grub bo// 'gro ba la phan thogs par gyur cig/1$0000250 ༈ rje btsun rat+na'i man+t+ra phā la ho/1$0000300 na mo gu ruḥ dzā ྷbīr pra mu kha sar+tha dzo ki ye na ma: dzo ki'i tshe sgrub ni/ nyi ma'i snga dgong dus gsum nyi ma la kha bltas la/ rang gi mdzod spur dzā ྷbīr bsam/ lag pa sa la reg pas mchod/ si si bu med na thal mo'i sgras mchod/ de nas man+t+ra cher bzlas pa dang*/ 'byung ba sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i rig 'dzin tshe'i grub thob dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams dang*/ nyi ma zla ba rnams zhu nas 'od rjid rjid rang gi khar zhugs/ sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa dag /lus 'chi ba med pa tshe'i bdud rtsis gang bar bsam/ 'khyor chu la sngags nas lan gsum 'thung*/ man+t+ra ni/ hūm̐ kā reḥ man ra weḥ a kā reḥ sa si ga da tsha tiḥ ma kā re shaḥ 'ga' ru ṇa/ 'gal tā+oḥ pra ṇā+oḥ pu ṇā tā+e tā+e tāḥ

ka ha ra ṇaḥ tā tā ka bha ra ṇaḥ 'od de bhā+o leḥ ka bhā+e ṇaḥ ma ta ṇaḥ se kyu rak+ṣaḥ ces pa'oḥ steng gdon nyi shar dang gung dang dgong gsum la gong ltar 'thungs pas nad las grol/ grib srung byed na dag par bris te g.yas g.yon lte ba mgo zhabs ma log par skud pa nag pos sgril la/ gang bsrung ba'i mgul du btags so// man+t+ra phā la hoḥ ༈ na mo pā ṇi badz+ra mā yī kāḥ e pa ṇi si wi/ nirma ho ka ha tro ni ru ṭe/ bh+ra ma na pā ke /kra kra ang 'ge /dzita dhe mā yi/ ni ang 'ag /shrī nā tha gi ang ga'o/ dzi bhi sha /pā ṇi pī wa/ dzi bhi sha thā kaḥ 'di dzā ྷbīr gyi man ngag snga dro tshar gsum pa ni/ 'thung thengs gsum/ dgong mo de dang 'dra/ skra dkar dang gnyer ma mi 'ong*/ rus pa mi rgas/ gzhon nur sdod pa'i man+t+ra/ gnod byed kyis nyen pa la'ang*/ sngags tshar gsum chu la btab nas blud pas phan no// dzo ki man+t+ra phā la ho/ ༈ ha ṭi ke kā+o thi/ tsa mā+o ki dhā pho pho/ a dhe tha/ tsan dhā li mā/ a ho tha mi yis man+t+ra 'di/ dus thams cad du bzlas na tshe ring bsod nams che/ thams cad dbang du 'du/ rang o rgyan du bheṃ/ ༈ rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas chu la brten nas tshe sring ba'i man+t+ra ni/ nyi ma shar dus shar du phyogs te/ yo byad tshogs par ldan pas/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i ngang nas/ oṃ na mo a dhi da ka pa ni bha h+ma bhiṣ+ṇa/ me ti pa tsa ni/ ka la ru ka dhe ka ka mu kha kha/ de bi rā dza/ pra dza/ bhas ka rā ni/ mai ri pad ka pa ni/ ghu hūm̐ ghu hūm̐/ a mas ghu hūm̐/ sa ta la ghu hūm̐/ ag+ne bha luṃ na hi/ lo ha tu dh+ru na hi/ pa ni dh+ru na hi/ tsan+t+ra si bhi dha/ su rdzi na pā pa/ me tsa tu/ he ra ha le/ ā ke his/ gha re pra ṇa dhe to/ hing gu la tshe/ si dha ṇo ṇa tha i dz+nyā bu re/ ī swā ra waḥtsaḥ zhes sngags tshar gsum re dang bstun te shar nub byang lho dbus rnams su chus mchod cing*/ rnal 'byor ma la dmigs te phyag gsum bya ba'i man+t+ra ni/

hing gu la tsa/ ma da pā tru ka na ma sa ta te/ zhes gsum mo// de nas dngos ni/ pur dza mthong bzhin par cung zad lag mthil du bzung ste/ oṃ na moḥ tri bhu mā ni/ sa gha sa mi/ sa ni si tu/ sa kha te/ tsa su tsha mi/ ma tsha tu/ pi kha o/ bhe la tu si tha o/ i shwa ra wa caḥ zhes lan bdun sngags dang bcas te chu 'thung*/ phyi nang phyi rol gyi nyi ma phyi chu nang gi nyi ma dbyer med par btung*/ slar yang chu mchod/ pū dza'i man ngag lan gsum re bzlas shing chu lhag ma la btab ste khrus bya/ rjes su nyi ma la bltas shing*/ shrī pur dza ya de wa tā pa du ka na masta te: zhes phyag gsum bya zhing dgong mo nyi ma ma gzhud gong kha nub tu bltas pas chu mchod/ sngon ma nub/ de nas shar byang lho dbus rnams su gtor ba ni khyad par ro// gnad kyi man ngag lag len thams cad gong bzhin no// de ltar ma chag par bgyis pa'i phan yon ni/ tshe ring nad med me chu mtshon gyi 'jigs pa bral/ rā dza pra dzā dbang du 'gyur/ bsod nams chen po dang ldan no// dzo ki'i man ngag go ༈ /yang nad drag po btab pa'i nad pa la/ gro phye la lug gi gzugs sngon po'am/ nad pa'i mtha' skor du/ rtsam pa/ nas/ mar/ sha chang gis bskor/ lug gi gdong la sin dhu ra byug /de nas nad pa'i mgo la g.yon skor lan gsum bya zhing*/ sngags 'di bzla/ bha la bhak+ṣu bha le rak+ṣu rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ghor ṣa nā tha gha ṭa paṇ+ḍi tai ri rak+ṣaḥ zhes bdun bzlas shing bskor nas/ khyi nag po la gtad de/ des sos par 'gyur ro/ ༈ /smyon pa 'dul na/ sngags 'di nyid lan bdun bzlas shing mdun du me mar gtams/ de'i mdun du nas tshom bdun bkod/ de nas blangs nas man ngag smyon pa'i gdong la brab/ rang srung na glang gi lci ba'i thal ba la bsngags nas mgo la gcig bskor nas/ dpral ba dang dpung pa la byug /des ni rang gzhan bsrung zhing bde bar 'gyur/ bhi bhu ta nā tha'i 'ang ngo*/ ༈ /chang byin rlabs byas 'thungs pas nyes pa med cing tshogs 'khor du 'gro ba'i man+t+ra ni/

tsakra shrī la bhan rung*/ bhan rung dā ri ma yi/ gha la bh+rar maḥgung*/ pa sā dha dhe dza ye/ zhes chang la chos 'byung bris pa'i dbus nas thig le blangs nas rtsa gsum lha tshogs mchod cing btab la 'thung*/ nyes pa med cing bdud rtsir 'gyur/ dz+wo ki'i tshe sgrub lugs kyi phyag ni man+t+ra/ ༈ gsum pa bzlas pa ni/ e ra na mo/ dha ra ṣa dhar ti si the tsa ma ṭa ma ta/ zhes lag pa la man+t+ra bzla/ tshogs dngos ni/ o ra na ma/ a mar dhar ni/ a mar me rī ka ya paṇ+ḍi tsho dha sra ma ka hūm̐ na dza yi/ shrī ghor ṣa nā tha sar+ṇa ces/ sba ra sa sbub te/ man+t+ra bzla'o// sa la brten nas sa'i tshe sgrub bha la nā tha'i man+t+ra a la'o// / ༈ dbang sdud bya ba ni dgong mo'i dus su dung chos su chu cung zad bzhag /nyi ma shar gong du chu de nas rang khar cung zad bzung ste/ man+t+ra bzlas/ chu de phyir phyung ste khrus pa'am/ yang na rang gi mchil mas gong ltar bya'o// man+t+ra/ oṃ ma ni dza le/ sarba dza ye/ a mṛta dza ye/ ka la kha e/ rā dza rā ni/ gu ru ma ni/ mu kha de khe/ me ha/ dza e/ sid+dhā gu ru gh+ro rak+ṣaḥ ma ha ni sa ri haṃ bha swa ham// /1$0000250 ༈ badz+ra nā tha'i man+t+ra dbang sdud bzhugs so// 1$0000300dzo ki badz+ra nā tha'i man+t+ra thams cad dbang du sdud 'dod pas zla ba sgra gcan dang nam 'phrad tshe/ nyi ma dang 'dra gsungs/ mkhal ma go yu rdog po chung ngu gnyis gcig gi khog brus dngul chu se ba gsum gyi tshad tsam blug kha gcod shing gis dam par byas// mtshams su spra tshil dag gis bgags// ri bong sgra gcan gzung ma thag /rdzas yod go yu man ngag ltar du mid// de nas sos la khad kyi dus// rdzas med go yu gong ltar du mid// gnyis ga ma byung bar du ni// zag pa bsags la nam byung tshe// dri bzang sogs kyis khrus byas la// longs spyod phun tshogs 'dod bya'i phyir// bum pa'i nang du rdzas yod bcug /bum chu 'gro ba rnams la blud// des ni snang srid dbang du 'dus// de las skyo na rdzas med kyi// go yu bum chu gong ltar lhung*// des ni 'du tshod na hi ang*// dzo ki'i man+t+ra pha la hoḥ

// 'di'i zhal gdams la// go yu rdzas yod pa'i dus ni// lung mgo byang bstan mdo lho dang*// rdzas yod kha ni byang du lta// rdzas med kha ni lho zhes grags/ kha gcod dag ni tsan+dan dmar pos bya// mtshams su skags kyi ro mas bgags// de yang de yi brjed tho tsam// gzhan la mi bstan bka' rgya yod// / ༈ kun tu bzang po'i thugs las byung ba'i sngags/ shrī gho rak+ṣa nā thas grub pa'i dbang phyug dzā ྷbīr la gnang*/ des badz+ra nā tha la gnang*/ des dzo ki ma ṇi ka nā tha la gnang*/ des rje rat+na'i zhabs la phul/ steng 'og spangs pa'i thad drang du// mig gi lta stangs cher byas la// sems ni gsal stong rang babs dang*// ngag tu sngags ni brgya rtsa bzlas/ ༈ /'dis ni kha char ser ba rlung*// gang byung ngos su btab pas bzlog /phar la gtad byas bzlog mi srid// byad dang rmi ltas ngan pa 'joms// nad pa'i snying la phus btab phan// 'gro ba'i rna bar lan gsum bzlas// phus btab pa yang phan yon mang*// skye res re la ngan song med// sngags chu kha ru blud pa yis// nad ni ngan song las grol zhing*// gdon bgegs gnod pa zhi ba dang*// gang la dmigs pa 'grub par 'gyur/ man+t+ra ni/ oṃ hūm̐/ tuṃ phaṭa swā hā/ sems ni g.yo zhing mi srun tshe// zhi ba'i dbyings su dag par 'gyur// rta dang khyi sogs mi srun pa// sngags bzlas de ma thag tu zhi// rang nyid o rgyan sgom pa yi// man ngag bla ma'i zhal las 'byung*/ zab// / man+t+ra 'di lan gsum bzlas te/ lag pa'i mthil du dngul chu se ba gsum tsam la btab 'thungs pas gris mi phed pa sogs bcud len gyi yon tan du ma dang ldan no// tsha dang skyur spong man+t+ra'o/ ༈ /oṃ tā ka tā ka ā ka ā ka pā ra pā sang*/ pā ra pā ra/ swā hūm̐/ zhes dz+wo ki pañtsa nā tha'i man+t+ra pha la ho/ ༈ rkun ma ngos 'dzin dgos par byung na/ stan dkar po'i steng du bu mo gtsang ma bzhag /gang dogs kyi ming yig bu mos snyob tshad du gral bya/

bu mos lag pa sa la ma reg tsam du lding du gzhug man+t+ra ci mang bzlas/ nas 'bras la bsngags te bu mo yi lag pa la brabs pas/ lag pa tsho ma thub par 'dar ba bzhin byas te/ rkun ma gang yin de'i ming bzung 'ong ngo*// man+t+ra 'di'o// oṃ 'ong swā bhir kha/ swā bhur kha/ swa bhir kha las swa bhur swa hā ka hā+e re/ bhā ṭa dhe bhur sa bkod/ bhu la dhe la ra ho rdza/ ha hing u dhā ka pi la/ pha ṭa mā+or ya/ ī shwa ra ma hā dhe wa/ ki dhu hā yi/ bha ho rā ba ra bha ti ke dhu ha yi/ tsa lo man+t+ra/ tsa lo ma he la ghu te/ gu rus sa gha te tsa lo man+t+ra tsa lo/ haṃ/ zhes bzlas so// dz+wo ki ma ni nā tha'i pha la hoḥ ཿ kha char gcod 'dod na/ ha ke ha ṇu sa tsa bhe hūm̐ dza ho pha ṭa phu ṭa/ me gha tsa pā+e shā hūm̐/ char ser byung ngos su lan gsum bzlas phus gdab/ mdzub ris bya/ pi pi bzlog pa bu des chod par the tshom med do// gu ru nā tha'i man+t+ra pha la ho// / bden tshig sgrub pa ngag gi nus chen dbang*// rang gzhan don la phan pa'i sems kyis ni// 'dod pa'i de nyid yid la byas nas kyang*// lag g.yon ming med srin mdzub gung mo dang*// mdzub mo rim bzhin bkal te bzhi brgya bzlas// de nas lag g.yas ming med nas brtsam ste// rim bzhin lag len bzhi brgya bzlas pa yis// brgya brgya bzlas pas don ni 'grub 'gyur te// nangs snga sngags bzlas gzhan ma 'dres gong du brjod// zhe sdang lang dus bya ba ma yin no// gang 'dod dbang du 'gyur ba'i bden tshig yin/ oṃ pā ra rā dza pā+e pā+e bha tuṃ/ 'di ni khyod kyis gzhan la ma sbyin zhes// bka' rgyas btab ste gzhan la gsang ste gnang// dzo ki bha dra'i man ngag pha la hoḥ ཿ1$0000250 ༈ dzo ki nas brgyud pa'i mgon po phyag bzhi pa bzhugs/ bka' rgya rgya/ 1$0000300man+t+ra 'di la rang ma hā kā ler bsgom/ skar ma bzang po la/ ghar ba lto skom spangs la/ lcags gzhu mtho gang la lcags kyi gzhu rgyud byas la/

lcags mda' sor dgu pa gcig bsgrub/ spra tshil la a mu ka'i liṅga sor bzhi pa gcig byas/ rang ma hā kā les a mu ka bkug nas bsad par bsam la/ ka li bzlas pa nyin bzhin bya/ dzo ki rna lung yod pa rmi ba sogs rtags myur du 'ong*/ zhag gnyis gsum lnga'i khongs su yong*/ sgrub ring sha chang dmar gtor gu gul sogs spos dang bcas pas mchod/ rtags byung nas liṅga la man+t+ra gsum bzlas pa gsum rang sgo bstun nas btab/ de nas mda' ling ga'i dkyil du snying gar brgyab/ de nas ras dgab/ ma shi tsam byed na de'i nangs par mda' 'don/ mda' brgyabs nas kyang man+t+ra tho re bzlas/ dgra dang bar chu 'bab pa med na bzang*/ zhag brgya re la gtor ma ma chag pa gtang*/ gtor mdun khrag gis bran la/ rang sngags mjug tu bha lin ta btags la 'bul/ mar me sogs mchod pa bshams la man+t+ra bzla'o// ཿ ka li bha li sa ti sa shar/ mi shi der/ a tha hā mi a shar kā li ka ma yi ke bha/ ha ṭha tsho dhe/ ma su khe/ san dha san dhe na he re/ bha ṇo a ki kā li kā si tshem pā no/ sarke dhā ne/ badz+ra na bhin du/ ma hā kā le wa bhai ro/ a mu ka tro ra san dhe ā ṇo ghor kī sa shar ma/ me ri bha kha ti/ i shwa sa bha tsha/ lha sgom pa'i tshe rang ma hā kā ler lam gyis sgom pa'i ngang nas mnyam par zhog ces gsungs so// gnad kyi man ngag zhal las dris so ang*/ rang dpal ma hā kā la phyag bzhi par bsgom/ me dpung rab tu 'bar zhing 'khrigs pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas bdag cag la gnod byed bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad me lce kha'i sbrang bu ltar thul thul bsregs par bsam la man+t+ra 'di bzlas so// badz+ra kā la bhe rong*/ bha ha ma dhi bhe rong*/ kaṅka bhe rong*/ a pa ke rak+ṣo/ bā phor bhe shas/ sim ra bha lo/ g+garki ba sha te me ri bha sha /ti i shwa ra wa tsa/ lan dgu bzlas/ thal mo rdeb thengs gsum re byed/ dgra bgegs dngos dod du yod na yid la byas te bzlas pa bgyis pas/

kho pa khrag skyug nas brlag par 'gyur ro// phreng ba rak+sha la bya/ gu gul gyi bdug pa bya'o// dus gsum du bzlas la thal mo brdeb/ gu ru de wa nā tha'i man+t+ra pha la ho/ ༈ grub pa'i dbang phyug dzā ྷbīr la na mo/ de las brgyud pa'i mgon po'i byad zlog 'di kho na'o// rang ma hā kā ler gsal btab la/ pha rol gyi byad phur mnan gtad thams cad me lce kha'i sbrang bu ltar/ gnod byed bsregs shing rdul du brlags par bsam la sngags 'di bzlas so// tsha lo ka re/ tshe du ka re/ bha du ka re/ bhi dz+nyā na kā re/ a ting siṇ+ḍo/ phu tri na ma te/ shrī nā tha ki /ang gying phu ro/ rang o rgyan du bsgom/ nangs re dgong mo man+t+ra tshar gsum re bzlas/ thal mo gsum brdeb/ byad 'dre'i gnod pa na hi/ mi gdon gyis nyen pa la srung mdud sngags chu gang 'dod byas/ stag sbrul phag bsrung ngo*//1$0000250 ༈ rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub skor/ 1$0000300rnal 'byor ma'i gdams pa zab mo dzo ki ma ṇi ka nas brgyud pa 'di'o// dang po tshes brgyad dang gza' nyi ma 'dzom pa la 'go brtsam ste bya'o// rang nyid rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas tri shū la dpung pa'i thad du bskum pa'i tshul dang*/ g.yon ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba 'thung ba'i stangs stabs kyis 'dzin pa la zhal phyogs pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum zhing g.yas brkyang pa gar stabs kyi tshul can thod pa skam po'i dbu rgyan dang*/ do shal can du mos nas bsnyen pa byed pa yin zhing*/ dus rgyun du'am khyad par tshes brgyad mchod pa'i dus su rang gi mdun du stegs kyi khar tsakra rtsibs lnga pa dang*/ drug pa dang*/ brgyad pa dpe'u chung ltar bzhengs pa bkod la/ ghi waṃ gis bris sam byug /maṇ+ḍal gyi mdun du bum pa dris gang ba dang*/ 'bras gtsang mas bkang ba'i snod sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga sbyar ba'i ka pā la/ mar me zhal zas rol mo'i bye brag /gu gul dang sha chen bsreg pa'i spos bhan+dha dang bcas pa bkod nas/

dza la/ swa dhung*/ tha la/ swa dhung swa dhung*/ dhā ra ti ma hī/ a ho tha ko ri/ bha swan dha ra swa dhung*/ swa dhung*/ a pa ni kā ya/ zhes lan gcig bzlas shing*/ gu gul gyis bdug /sngags dang*/ gnas yul gyi grib dang mi gtsang ba yod pa'i sar 'gro ba dang 'dug nas rang bsrung na rang bzla zhing nye 'khor du btab/ 'khor bsrung na ci mang bzlas shing gang srung ba'i gnas khang du gdab/ des ni gnas khang sbyang zhing grib kyis nyes par mi 'gyur zhing*/ bza' btung la btab kyang zas grib dang mi gtsang ba thub bo// de nas rang tsakra'i lte bar rnal 'byor ma gong bzhin gsal ba'i phreng ba zhal shes ltar bzung nas/ oṃ a yang*/ kli yang swā hāḥ zhes bsnyen pa brgya rtsa brgyad bya/ de nas chang mchod gtsang ma logs su bkod pa la/ shi 'o mar/ khā ṭa/ sha dkar sa pā ni/

mang po mang po/ girnya mar/ kung dung byang sems/ pā tri/ ri wi/ bha ro/ bhin+dha/ ma tā na/ ko ṭa/ bhang re mi/ tī pa tī/ swā hāṃ/ zhes bris te chang la chos 'byung lag len ltar bris pa'i dbus nas tsakra la mchod cing mchod pa rnams btegs/ rang yang longs spyad/ rjes kyi phyag dang*/ mchod pa ni/ bha la ti su ra/ kung ta ti/ sa ru ka na/ mas ta te/ zhes chu nyer spyod rol mos kyang mchod/ rjes su maṇ+ḍal bsdu ba dang*/ yang dkyil 'khor bkram pa dang*/ sgo dbye gcod kyi sngags ni/ san du/ dho he/ ma ta/ bu dzuṃ/ pū pa/ mā a/ ang bha ra/ dza ho/ saṃ no/ mo ṣa/ mo ṣa te/ gha ti/ bhu ha ra/ zhes bzlas so// 'di ni sngags te/ dben sar rang gis nyams su blangs na/ phan yon ni tshe ring nad nyung*/ bsam don 'grub/ thams cad dbang du 'du nges/ mthar rdo rje rnal 'byor mas rjes su bzung nas sangs rgyas par gdon mi za'o// gal te grogs sam 'khor gyis sa maṇ+ḍal mthong dogs pa byung na/ gnas khang gtsang byed dang*/ sgo 'byed gcod man+t+ra gsum re bzlas la rna bar btab la bya'o// phreng ba man ngag zhal las shes so// ཿ1$0000250 ༈ rlung khrid kyi cha lag /1$0000300rkang mgyogs rlung gi gdams pa la/ lus gnad bca' ba legs par bya/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur mchan khung du bcug /dmigs pa ni/ rlung gi lha mo sku mdog sngo skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rang gi mchan 'og gnyis nas yar 'gyogs par bsgom/ 'gro 'dug gi dus gom pa che chung*/ dmigs pa dang sbrags nas rlung yar 'then lus zam byed pa yin gsungs/ ༈ sbrul gyi rlung ni/ lus gnad bsrang skyil krung bya/ lag pa pus steng bzhag rlung phar 'gro sna nas gtong zhing kha nas rlung sgra med par dal bus mchil ma dang mnyam du gsus pa ma khengs bar yang yang mid/ de ltar brtson 'grus bskyed pas skyi brjes nas yong gsungs/ ༈ gti mug sangs par byed pa'i rlung gnad 'phrul 'khor la/

lus skyil krung cung zad sgur/ lag pa mdun nas gshibs/ mgrin pa sgur/ dpung pa phyir phab/ 'jing pa yar 'then/ rlung ni dgang zhing 'dzin pa dang mgo la shed kyis gcud pas/ tshangs bug nas rlung sngo bun gyis thon yong gsungs/ yong gi'ang snang/ ༈ gro shog srab mor bzang drug bsres/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ bhan+dha yā bhan+dha yā/ tshin+dha tshin+dha yā/ bhin+dha bhin+dha yā/ star star yā/ so sha yā/ so sha yā/ sne tra yā sne tra yā swā hā: oṃ kun dhe le ku saṃ/ cil la ma 'brum shal la swā hā khrag nad rgyu gzer shīn+taṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ mtshal gyis lhag chad med par bris/ gong ma brgya brgyad po nyer cig gis rab tu gnas/ bum par chu mig shar lta'i chur bzang drug btab thum dkar por byas/ steng du sngags thum dmar byas la/ gang gis ma mthong bar mdun du bzhag /de shel gyi gzhal yas khang du mkha' 'gro dzam ti dar dkar na bza' rin chen rgyan phreng can g.yas 'tsho byed kyi bum pa/ g.yon nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa/ sku yi 'od kyis nad kun zhi bar bsam/ sngags brgya stong nad tshabs dang sbyar la sgrub/ mthar 'od zhu bdud rtsi bstim/ gang bsrung gdags shing bum chu blud/ mang du bsrung na khrus chu bkye/ bal dkar sngags pa'i srung ba gdags/ rang nyid nad yod sar 'gro na/ dri chur bsngags pas nges par thub/ dbang po rnams su byug go /dkon mchog rat+nas so//1$0000250 ༈ dzo ki man+t+ra pā la/ 1$0000300grub thob gho rak+ṣa nā thasaḥ dzo ki brah+ma nā tha la gnang ba'i tshe sgrub kyi man+t+ra/ tshe lam gyi nad sel gyi dpe ris/ oṃ na mo ga rī ba nā thamaḥ ma hā ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ a gaṃ maṃḥ a hūm̐ḥ a suṃ ṭaṃ swāṃ hūm̐ hā swāhā oṃḥ sngags 'di gnyis lag g.yas kyi dkyil mdzub kyi tshigs gsum pa'i ltas shar nas ri rtse la nyi ma shar ba'i tshe chu 'khyor ba gang la sngags tshar gcig bzlas/ oṃ zhes pa'i dus su btung*/ dgong mo yang btung*/

snga dro phyogs shar dang dgong mo nub tu blta/ de ltar byas pas tshe lam gyi ri mo yal nges/ yang tshe lam gnyis pa chad dam/ 'chi ltas gnyis ka shar na/ ྈpā+o ྸྸཾ shrī aṃ/ ka li ྸྸཾཿ ྸྸཾ dzi maṃ swā hāḥ sngags 'di snga dro gong ltar ngag tu lan gsum bzlas steng*/ hūm̐ zhes tshe chu 'thung*/ dus gsum kha lta ba gong ltar bya/ nad mi 'byung zhing tshe ring bar 'gyur/ bka' gsang rgya rgya: zab:1$0000250 ༈ grub chen dzā ྷbīr gyi snyan brgyud zab mo bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo rat+na gu ru/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dzā ྷྦཱིra las brgyud pa'i gdams pa 'di la gnyis te/ brgyud pa'i rim pa dang*/ gdams pa dngos so// dang po ni/ o rgyan gu ru/ mgon po chen po/ dzā ྷྦཱིra te bla ma de dag 'ja' lus su grub pa brnyes te/ da lta yang skal ba dang ldan pa tha dag gis zhal dngos su mjal zhing gsung gi gdams pa nod par nus pa sha stag go /grub chen dzā ྷྦཱིra gyi slob ma ni/ bdag gi bla ma badz+ra nā tha ste/ rang lo nyer bzhi pa la mjal zhing gdams pa 'di rnams nod par bgyis pa'o/ lo rgyus rgyas par zhal las dris/ gnyis pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa ni/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum mo// dang po ni/ tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas sgrub par byed pa la bar gcod kyis mi tshugs pa sngags srung gi man ngag /zas dug bsrung ba bi ṣa stobs 'joms kyi man ngag /pha rol rig sngags kyi nus pa gzhom pa byad zlog gi man ngag ste/ zur du gsal/ bzhi po 'di ni sngon 'gro phran bu'i skor ro// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ kha zas kyi 'khri ba gcod cing 'ja' lus sgrub par byed pa 'byung lnga'i rlung zas su bza' ba'i dmigs pa/ rgyun khyer gyi man ngag rlung 'chug med du 'jug pa dbu ma gsal byed dang*/ rtsa lam sbyang ba dbu ma bskor ba'i rlung dang 'phrul 'khor gyi man ngag /bde ba'i gnad bskul zhing rtsal sbyang bogs 'don pa thig le dkar dmar dmigs pa'i man ngag

/de'i tshe kun+da'i gegs srung zhing bzung ba rtsa rlung them bu'i man ngag /byang sems gyen du 'dren cing lus kun la 'grem pa'i rlung gnad 'phrul 'khor gyi man ngag /phung po lhag med kyi 'ja' lus sgrub pa dmigs pa kha bsgyur gyi man ngag rnams so// gsum pa rjes phran bu'i skor la gnyis te/ rlung sbyor dang sngags la brten pa'o// dngos kyi gnas skabs kyi gegs sel/ stod gzer dang sbos khrog gzhom zhing stod smad kyi gegs sel zhing rlung dang 'phrul 'khor gyi man ngag /mig dang rna bar rlung 'dzin cing gzhil ba dang*/ rmongs pa ngo mtshar bskyed pa rlung sor mo la 'grems pa'i man ngag /snying rlung dang*/ chu gzhi/ sha lhad 'don pa'i dmigs pa rlung gnad 'phrul 'khor gyi man ngag /gsang ba sbubs su sbas te gtsug tor sgrub pa/ de dag gi gegs sel ba'i rlung gnad 'phrul 'khor gyi man ngag /tsha grang gi nad skyug tu 'dren pa dang sbyang ba'i rlung gnad 'phrul 'khor gyi man ngag rnams so// sngags la brten pa'i skor la/ gzhan snang dbang du sdud cing bsod nams kyi stobs bskyed pa'i sngags kyi man ngag /lus stod smad kyi skrangs 'bur dang*/ rmen bu khros pa zhi bar byed pa'i sngags kyi man ngag /mda' mdung mtshon cha'i ngar dbal rdugs par byed pa/ sa la brten pa dang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo sngags kyi man ngag /mdze nad dang*/ pho nad sogs sgos su bcos par byed pa la chu la brten pa'i man ngag gzhan phan ser ba bsrung ba/ gtor ma bca' zhing sngags la brten pa'i man ngag rnams mchis pa las/ sngags la brten pa rnams ni zur du gsal/ 'dir dngos gzhi dang rlung sbyor phran bu rnams ston te/ dang po kha zas kyi 'khri ba gcod cing 'ja' lus sgrub pa 'byung lnga'i rlung zas su bza' ba dmigs pa rgyun khyer gyi man ngag 'di la lnga ste/ sngon 'gro lus kyi gnad bstan pa dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rlung lnga'i kha dog gsal btab la bsdu ba dang*/

rlung zhi bar za ba dang*/ drag por za ba dang*/ btsan thabs su za ba'o// dang po ni/ dben pa'i gnas su mtshams dam par bcad grib la 'dzem stan gyi rgyab mtho ba la 'khod de/ rkang pa g.yon gyi rting pas gsang ba'i rtsa chen mnan/ g.yas kyi rting pa spu mtshams su gtad pa'i rkang sor gyi rtse sar btsugs la brten/ lag gnyis thal mo pus steng bkan cing lus shin tu drang ba la/ mgrin pa sgur pas stod mgo non par bya/ mig mdun gyi gnya' shing gang tsam gyi sar rang babs su lta stangs bya'o// gnyis pa bla rnal rlung lnga'i kha dog gsal bar bsdu ba ni/ ngag tu oṃ na mo na mo na mo/ dzā ྷbīr dza ྷbīr dzā ྷbīr zhes brjod/ srin lag g.yas la mchil ma btab ste smin mtshams su byug go /dmigs pa ni smin mtshams su grub chen dzā ྷbīr de nyid rab byung gi cha byad can/ phyag gnyis dbu'i gtsug tu thal mo sbyar zhing zhabs gnyis mthil gnyis sprad de bzhengs pa'i sku tshon gang pa'am nas 'bras tsam pa lam mer bzhugs pa la sems gtad/ de'i ngang las phyi rol gyi snang ba'i dngos po thams cad kyi ngo bo sa rlung ser po/ chu rlung dkar po/ me rlung dmar po/ rlung gi rlung ljang gu /nam mkha'i rlung sngon po rnams gsal btab la/ rngub pa'i tshe rlung kha dog lnga ldan nar gyis drangs nas lus khengs par bsgom mo// gsum pa rlung zhi bar bza' ba ni/ lus gnad snga ma de nyid las rlung ro phyir 'bud/ de rjes gzhur te rngubs la rtsol bcas kyi mchil ma mid pa yang yang bya ste/ rlung gis gang bar gyur gyur gyi bar bya'o// des ni rlung gegs mi 'byung zhing 'byongs pa'i dgos pa yod do// bzhi pa drag por bza' ba ni/ lus gnad dang dmigs pa sngar ltar la/ rlung ro sgra bcas su 'bud/ de nas sgra bcas su rngubs la kha btsum pa dgang la mchil ma sgra bcas su mid/ tshad sngar ltar ro// lnga pa btsan thabs su bza' ba ni/ rlung ro sgra bcas su 'bud cing lto ba gcar/

'pho ba 'chun btsal/ lkog ma dang mid pa mdun du brgyangs la/ mgrin pa nas rlung sgra bcas su skad cig gis 'jug ste/ nang khengs pa dang cung zad mnan/ gsum gar rgyab rlung rang sor 'jog la/ 'dor ba spang*/ dmigs pa ni gsum ka 'dra'o// 'di dag ni nyams len rgyun khyer te rgyun du nyams su blang bar bya'o// gnyis pa rlung 'chug med du 'jug pa dbu ma gsal byed dang*/ rtsa lam sbyang ba dbu ma bskor ba'i 'phrul 'khor dang rlung gnad kyi man ngag ni/ lus sgur te lang ba'i rkang pa gnyis kyi bar la skum khru gang yod par bya/ pus steng lag gnyis bzhag la rked pa bsrang*/ steng rlung 'phul nas bcad/ long gnyis gnon/ mdun rlung 'chun btsal la drangs/ 'byongs tshe rkang tshugs par 'gyur ro// de nyid las dbu ma'i g.yas g.yon du 'chun res mos su bya zhing bskor ba'o// rlung gnad ni gong bzhin no// gsum pa bde ba'i gnad skul zhing bogs 'don pa thig le dkar dmar dmigs pa'i man ngag la gnyis te/ lus gnad de nyid las/ rang lus rtsa dbu ma kha dog sngon po rtsa ba phra ba/ kha gdengs rgyas pa/ lus tshad dang mnyam pa'i yar sner dwangs ma dkar po dang*/ mar sner dwangs ma dmar po byi'u'i sgo nga tsam bsam/ rlung gong ltar la/ thig le dkar dmar dbu ma'i rked par 'phrad pa'i tshe/ dbu ma g.yas su bskor tshe dkar pos dmar po 'bros ded kyi tshul du 'khor ba dang*/ g.yon du 'khor dus dmar pos dkar po gong bzhin 'ded par bsgom pa ni sbyang ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'phrul 'khor dang rlung gnad sngar ltar la/ thig le dkar po mar babs te/ dmar po'i 'og tu slebs pa na/ dbu ma g.yas su bskor dus dkar pos dmar po ded nas tshangs bug gi bar du 'gro ba dang*/ g.yon du bskor dus dmar pos dkar po ded de gsang gnas bar 'gro bar sgom zhing 'bad pas/ rlung dbu mar tshud drags mgo bo na zhing gzer ba 'byung*/ bde ba'i nyams rtsol med du 'char ro// thun mtshams rnams su thig le dkar dmar so sor bzhag go

/'di'i skabs su bde ba'i shugs chen po 'bar te/ byang sems 'pho ba'i skyon du 'gyur nye ba na/ bzhi pa kun da'i gegs bsrung zhing bzung ba rtsa rlung them bu'i man ngag la gnyis te/ rtsa them dang rlung them mo// dang po ni rgyun 'khyer gyi rlung gnad kho na'o// gnyis pa rlung them ni/ rtsol med kyi 'pho rlung mdun du phul/ lte ba rgal tshigs la bcar te 'then/ rtsa them dang sbyar ba bya'o// de ni gegs bsrung zhing bzung ba'o// lnga pa byang sems gyen la 'dren cing lus kun la 'grem pa'i rlung gnad 'phrul 'khor gyi man ngag la gnyis te/ 'dren pa dang 'grem pa'o// dang po la'ang gnyis te/ lus stod la 'dren pa dang*/ mgo la 'dren pa'o// dang po rkang pa'i lus gnad sngar ltar la/ lag gnyis mdun du gshibs te brkyang*/ rtsol med kyi rlung rngub chung byas la stod du btsud cing lus stod sor mo la 'chun btsal lo// gnyis pa mgo la 'dren pa ni/ rkang gnad sngar ltar la/ lag gnyis pus steng bkab pa la drang por rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi rlung mgrin pa dang mgo bor btsud cing 'chun dmigs la btsal lo// gnyis pa 'grem pa ni/ rkang pa skyil krung lag gnyis pus steng bzhag la/ rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi rlung brgyangs la/ lus dang mgo bo g.yas su gcu zhing*/ pus mo g.yon gyi mgo lag pa g.yas kyis nang du 'then pa dang*/ 'phrul 'khor de nyid bsgyur bar bya zhing*/ lus kun la 'chun btsal lo// drug pa phung po lhag med 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'i dmigs pa kha bsgyur gyi man ngag ni/ 'phrul 'khor dang rlung gnad dbu mar ka 'dzugs dang 'dra ba la/ rlung gnad phyir dbyung ba'i tshe/ rang gi sdig sgrib nad gdon bgegs skyon rnams du ba'i rnam pas sngo bun bun thon/ slar yang sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma thams cad kyi byin rlabs/ brtan g.yo'i bcud rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par byon/

dbu ma'i nang thams cad gang/ dbu ma rang yang 'od kyi rnam par bsam zhing*/ dmigs pa dang sbyar te g.yas g.yon du bskor ba sngar bzhin no// de ltar skabs skabs su bogs 'don la rtsal sbyang zhing*/ dus kun tu rgyun khyer gyi nyams len la 'bad par bya'o// gsum pa rjes gegs sel dang*/ phran bu'i 'phrul 'khor rlung gnad kyi man ngag skor la brgyad las/ dang po stod gzer dang sbos khrog gzhom pa dang*/ sems kyi bzhag thabs zhal las shes/ stod smad kyi gegs sel ba'i rlung gnad 'phrul 'khor gyi man ngag ni bzhi ste/ rtsol med rgyun khyer gyi man ngag nyams su blangs pa'i tshe/ ro stod gzer ba dang*/ sbos shing rtsibs logs phan tshun bsdoms pa ltar na ba sogs byung na sel ba'i rlung gnad 'phrul 'khor ni/ lus bsrang zhing rkang pa rtsa them ltar la rtsol med kyi rlung dgang zhing cung zad mnan/ lag pa mdun du 'phang zhing stod kyi rlung sel la brdeg go /gnyis pa smad sbos shing khrog pa dang na zug byung na/ 'phrul 'khor dang rlung gnad sngar ltar la/ rdo rje khu tshur pho stod pho smad du rdeg cing 'beb bya ba dang*/ gru 'beb bya ba spel mar bya'o// gsum pa stod gegs rlung sgregs 'chor ba sel ba'i rlung gnad 'phrul 'khor ni/ rgyun khyer ltar la sor mo pus steng du 'chun btsal la rgyun ring smad par bya'o// bzhi pa smad kyi gegs sel ba ni/ 'og rlung 'chor tshad na/ lus gnad sngar ltar las cung zad sgur zhing*/ lag pa pus steng srang zhing dbu ma ka 'dzugs kyis sel lo// gnyis pa mig dang rna bar rlung 'dzin cing gzhil ba dang*/ rmongs pa ngo mtshar bskyed pa rlung sor mo la 'grem pa'i rlung gnad dang 'phrul 'khor gyi man ngag la gsum ste/ dang po mig la rlung 'dzin cing gzhil ba ni/ lus gnad rgyun khyer sngar ltar las/ rna ba'i bug pa them bus bkag ste/ rlung phyir bus rjes lag g.yas mtheb mdzub kyis rna gshog bsdams nas/

mig sgril zhing rlung nang du 'then pas sgra bcas su 'byung*/ phyir gzhil ba la yang lus gnad de las rlung phyir 'don pa'o// gnyis pa rna bar rlung 'dzin pa dang gzhil ba ni/ rna ba'i bug pa gsal te sngar bzhin no// phan yon ni rna ba dang mig la skyon mi 'byung zhing*/ lha'i rna mig gi mngon shes dang ldan par 'gyur ro// gsum pa sor mo la rlung dgram pa ni/ lus gnad rgyun khyer ltar ram/ 'dren gyi 'phrul 'khor ltar las/ rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi rlung stod du brgyangs te lag nya sor mor bsgyur zhing 'chun btsal bas/ dang po rtsa gsal zhing 'byongs tshe thal ba spur nus so// bzhi pa snying rlung gi gegs sel ba'i 'phrul 'khor dang rlung sbyor dmigs pa ni/ rkang pa gnyis mthil sprad pa'i sor mo lag gnyis kyis sbar 'dzings su bsdam/ rlung sbyor ka 'dzugs ltar la/ dbu ma sngar bzhin gsal btab pa'i yar snar/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor

bla ma'i bzhugs tshul zhal las shes/ gong bzhin gsal ba la yar 'then dus bla ma dbu ma'i nang brgyud/ sa'i gting du mar byon pa la sems gtad/ yang rkang mgo la chun btsal/ phyir 'then cing 'beb pa'i dus/ bla ma yar byon smin phrag gi thad du bzhugs pa la sems gtad cing*/ sa 'og gi dmigs pa rgyun bsring bar bya'o// lnga pa chu ser gyis lus dang yan lag skrangs pa sogs la/ dbu ma btsugs pa'i nang du yan lag gi chu ser bsdus par dmigs shing*/ chu ser bsdu ba'i 'phrul 'khor lag len zhal las shes/ dang rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi rlung gis lus dgang zhing*/ srog rlung gi 'phrul 'khor ltar la 'beb bya ba dang*/ yang rkang pa skyil krung tsog pu lag sor g.yon g.yas kyis bzung ba'i nang sarabastan la 'beb bya'o// des ni chu ser gshang sgo nas thon 'ong ngo*// drug pa sha lhad 'don pa'i 'phrul 'khor dang rlung gnad ni/ rkang pa dang lag pa bsnol la sgreng zhing*/ rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi rlung sgang la lus kun la 'chun btsal lo// bdun pa sba ba sbubs 'dren gyi 'phrul 'khor la gny-is te/ sbyang ba dang gegs sel ba'o// dang po rkang pa gnyis pus mo btsugs pa'i bar du 'khyud gang yod par bya zhing*/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur pus steng bzhag la rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi mdun rlung brgyangs shing phyir 'phul/ rgyab rlung drag tu 'then la 'chun btsal lo// gnyis pa ni gang gi 'phrul 'khor dang rlung gnad la 'bad pas dri chu sdom pa'i gegs byung na lus gnad sngar ltar la/ lag pa mdun du brgyangs shing stod kyi rlung seng du rdog pa gsum gyi rjes su rkang pa mdun du brkyang zhing lus byings sa la 'beb rlung gnad gong bzhin no// brgyad pa tsha grang gi nad skyug tu 'don pa dang sbyang ba'i rlung gnad 'phrul 'khor gyi man ngag ni/ rtsol bcas dang rtsol med kyi rlung dang ldan pas/ chu skol dang grang mo gang rung 'thung zhing*/

lus gnad rgyun 'khyer ltar las dkrug pa'i 'phrul 'khor la 'bad cing*/ sgregs pa bton pas skyug 'byung zhing*/ gsang sgo la'ang nad 'thon no// gnad kyi man ngag lag pa'i 'phrul 'khor dang*/ rna mig gnyis kyi gegs sel khyad par rlung skom du 'thung ba rnams zhal las shes so// de ltar tshe gcig gis mtshungs med 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i rlung dang 'phrul 'khor gyi gdams pa zab mo lam gyi cha lag tshang la ma nor rdzogs pa 'di nyid dus bskal gyi dbang gis gzhan la sbyin pa'i chos su ma mthong yang*/ dad pa dang dam tshig tu ldan pa'i slob ma mang zhig gis bskul ba la brten/ 'bri khung gi phyogs su gnas pa'i ldom bu ba rat+na'i ming can gyis shing pho rta'i lo hor zla brgyad pa'i yar tshes bzang po la/ gter sgrom brag dkar du sbyar ba yin pas/ phyis 'byung lam 'dir mos pa kun kyang sgrub pa'i me tog dang bcas nas nyams su len pa dang*/ snying nas chos byed ma gtogs pa la dpe dang gdams pa sbyin na/ 'di nyid kyi bka' srung drang srong gza' brgyad kyis snying khrag thang la phos shig /ཿ1$0000250 ༈ rlung khrid brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru/ ka dag rang byung dbyings kyi pho brang na// chos sku 'od mi 'gyur la gsol ba 'debs// phung po zag med 'ja' lus 'grub pa dang*// tshe 'dir mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/1$0000250 tshig 'og ma gnyis kun la 'gre/1$0000300 lhun grub bde ba chen po'i pho brang na// longs sku spyan ras gzigs la gsol ba 'debs/ == thugs rje phyogs lhung bral ba'i pho brang na// o rgyan yab yum sku la gsol ba 'debs/ == 'khrul pa'i mtshan ma rang grol pho brang na// ma hā nā tha'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ == rtsal snang kun rgyas bde chen pho brang na// grub chen dzā ha bīr la gsol ba 'debs/ == sku dang ye shes mthar phyin pho brang na// badz+ra nā tha'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/

== zag med bde chen rdo rje'i pho brang na// mkha' grol klong yangs zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// == 'khor 'das mnyam yangs lhun grub pho brang na// dharma pā la'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ == rnam kun mchog ldan zung 'jug pho brang na// mkhan chen rnam 'joms zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ == zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i pho brang na/ rig 'dzin chos kyi grags pa la gsol ba 'debs/ == bslab gsum 'khor lo gnyis kyi pho brang na// dkon mchog lhun grub zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ == mdzod spu mi shigs 'khor lo'i pho brang na// rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ == zab lam bstan pa mtha' rgyas pho brang na// bka' srung drang srong brgyad la gsol ba 'debs/ == de ltar rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma dang*// bka' srung rnams la gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// rdo rje theg pa'i lam 'dir rab zhugs pa'i// rdo rje mched lcam ma lus thams cad kyi// gnas skabs mthar thug bar chad kun zhi zhing// 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku 'grub nas// ma gyur 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kyang*// rnam mkhyen rgyal ba'i sa la 'god gyur cig /ces pa 'di lung rtogs kyi yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i bla ma rab yangs pa sogs dad ldan 'gas bskul ba las/ 'bri gung pa rat+na'i ming can gyis sbyar ba'o//1$0000250 ༈ nam mkha' zhal mjal bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo rat+na gu ru dzā ha bīr la na mo/ thabs shes zung ni brtsegs pa'i gdan stengs su// ri rgyal lhun po 'gying zhing rab tu brtan// dpag bsam ljon pa'i zungs can 'phrang zhing ldan// rnam rgyal khang bzang dkar gsal steng du phye// rlung lha pho mo zom chen nang du nyal// ri rab them skas nang nas spar zhing sbud// de tshe rang rig nyi zla'i lha zhal mthong*// zhes pa 'di ni mkha' zhal mjal ba ste// gnas chen gter sgrom brag dkar dben gnas su// bzang po'i tshes la rat+na lak+ṣ+mīs// zhal las smras te dug lnga'i dgra las rgyal// gdod ma'i gnas mchog gang de mthong gyur cig

// 1$0000250༈ zab lam snyan brgyud bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī yai/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'dud// 'khrul snang shar ba'i gdams pa'i brjed tho zhig /phyi rol rnams la phan blos bri bar bya// bzod par gsol zhing bka' yi rgya khrol zhu// steng 'og rlung ni dbu ma'i khyim du gzhug /gling bzhi rab bgrod ri rab lto ba gdengs/ de ni dbu ma'i rlung gi lam sbyong ste// rtsa gnas ma khrems bar du 'di la 'bad// dngos gzhi'i rlung gnad gong dang 'dra ba las// gling bzhi ri rab 'phang zhing rdeb pa ni// 'chun ldan rab tu sgrim pa'i ngang nyid las// grangs med ci nus bar du 'bad cing bsnun// rjes bar nyi zla mun par mngon sum lta// phyi nang dbyer med don dang ma ldan bar// tha ma ya bral bar du mi gcod cing*// rang babs gtad med ngang la 'bad pa gces// zhes pa 'di yang snyom las sdom bu ba// rat+na'i ming can bdag gis bris pa 'dis// ma gyur 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kun// kun bzang he ru ka dang dbyer med shog /dge'o// 1$0000250༈ rlung khrid 'phrul 'khor gyi rtsa tshig bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru we/ grub pa'i dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// dzā ha bīr brgyud rlung khrid kyi// bca' ba lus kyi 'phrul 'khor la// dang po rgyun khyer rtsa ba'i lus kyi bzhi pa/ dang*// gnyis pa/ dbu ma gsum pa/ gsal byed bskor ba'o// rtsa them rgyun khyer 'phrul 'khor mtshungs// lnga pa/ stod dang mgo la 'dren pa gnyis// 'gram chen gcig chog rgyal po 'am// drug pa/ 'ja' lus 'phrul 'khor dbu ma bskor// dang po/ stod rlung gzer 'doms 'phrul 'khor dang*// sbos 'joms khrog sel 'phrul 'khor dang*// sgregs gnon thur sel dbang sdud do// gnyis pa/ mig rlung 'dzin gzhil mig 'phrul 'khor// rna rlung 'dzin gzhil rna'i 'phrul 'khor//

gsum pa/ lag sor rlung dgram 'phrul 'khor dang*// bzhi pa/ snying rlung sel ba'i 'phrul 'khor dang*// lnga pa/ chu ser bsdu zhing drangs dbab 'beb// sha lhad 'don pa'i 'phrul 'khor drug pa/ dang*// sba ba sbubs 'dren 'phrul 'khor bdun pa/ dang*/ de yi gegs sel 'phrul 'khor dang*// tsha grang nad 'don dkrugs brgyad pa/ 'phrul 'khor// mig dang rna ba'i gegs sel gnyis// de ltar gzhung bstan 'di nyid la// gegs sel bogs 'don 'phrul 'khor ni// bgrang mi lang ba du ma 'byung*// nam mkha' zhal mjal lus gnad gcig /zab lam snyan brgyud rlung zhug gnyis// dgram chen rlung la 'phrul 'khor gcig /sbyang spel spar ba'i tshig rdzogs so// zhes pa zab lam rlung khrid kyi// 'phrul 'khor rkang grangs rtsa tshig 'di// dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis// bskul te 'bri gung rat+na yis// rgya ma khri sgang dag tu bkod// maṅga laṃ//1$0000250 ༈ dpal grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dzā habīr las brgyud pa'i rlung khrid las/ 'byung 'khrugs kyi gegs sel nad 'joms bdud rtsi'i bum pa bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī yai/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir zab lam mkha' spyod myur 'dren/ rlung la brten pa'i nyams len/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dzā ྷིbār zhes yongs su grags pa de las brgyud pa'i gdams pa 'di nyid nyams su blang ba la/ gang zag 'byung ba'i sgyu lus byer zug snyoms pa'i khyad par las/ gegs sel lugs kyi man ngag la ma rmongs pa gal che ste/ gtso bor lam 'di nyams su blangs pas man ngag gi gsang la nges pa rnyed pa ni/ bdag gzhan gyi 'du ba cha snyoms par bya ba'i phyir/ gegs gang gis sel zhing bogs gang gis 'don par bya ba ni/ rlung rig gi 'dun pas bsgyur zhing dpyad pa na/

'char bar 'gyur bas las la sbyar bas don 'grub par 'gyur ro// de ltar mi ldan na gnas skabs kyi gegs sel nye bar mkho ba 'ga' zhig bri bar bya ste/ de yang thog mar rlung zhi drag gang bza' yang*/ gre ba skam pa lta bur gyur nas rlung sgra bcas dang sgra med/ phyi 'gro dang nang 'gro ma go bar rlung mid ma shes na/ snod kyi nang du chu cung zad khyer mchu la sbyar nas drang zhing*/ chu dang mnyam du mid pas shes par 'gyur zhing*/ yang rlung zos pas chu mid pa la na zug dang rke 'chus pa lta bus rlung 'chun dka' na/ lus gnad tsog pur bya/ lag gnyis mgo bor sor mo bsnol te bsdam/ rked pa bsrang*/ rlung bzung la/ gzhan gyis rgyab nas tshigs pa drug bdun gyi thog tu pus mo gtad de/ lag pas stod nas bsdam/ phyir ltag 'then drag tu byas la/ rlung dbyung dus kha sna nas sgra bcas su bus pas sel lo// yang mdun stod brgyangs pa lta bu dang*/ sgrog rus 'bral snyam byed pa/ mid pa 'chus pa lta bu byung ba dang*/ rgyab dang ro stod sgregs nas gzer ba lta bus rlung chud mi bde na lang pa'i lag pa sbar 'dzings kyis mgo nas bsdam/ rlung bsdam pa'i rgyab sog phrag tu ras sam snam bu'am gang rung gis pho ldo khu tshur nyis sgril tsam bzhag la/ grogs kyis rgyab nas bsdams te 'degs 'jog ci mang dang*/ yang sgrog rus la khu tshur rdeg cing*/ rke dang gnya' ba lag pas gshud/ mar dkar gyi byug pa bya zhing*/ rlung gcud pa'i rke la 'chun btsal la/ g.yas g.yon du bskor ba rnams byas pas rlung chud bde bar 'gyur ro// de ltar rlung bcug nas mgo bo na zhing gzer na/ rlung bzung bas lag pa mgo la rdeg pa mang du bya'o// yang rlung lus kyi gzhogs gcig la chud cing/ gcig la ma chud na/ gang ma chud pa phyogs kyi stod smad kun la rlung la bcud la 'chun btsal/ rkang lag mgo sogs lag pa gshud pa mang du byas la/

nyal tshe rlung ma 'chud pa'i phyogs kyi gzhogs sa la phab ste nyal bas rlung yo ba srong bar 'gyur ro// yang lag pa sbrid pa dang*/ tshigs chen dang sog tshigs na ba sogs byung na/ rlung bcud pa'i na sa 'phur zhing srog rtsol gyi rlung lag pa la 'chun btsal/ mkhrig ma na na lag pa pad kor gong ltar byas la tshigs su mar gsar gyis byug pa thems par bya/ yang dpung tshigs dang ro stod gzer na/ lus srong lag gnyis rang babs su pus steng bzhag ste rlung bcug la/ dpung pa phyi nang bskor ba re mos dang*/ mnyam du bskor ba'i 'phrul 'khor byas pas sel lo// yang bar rlung stod du brgyangs nas mgo bo na zhing*/ dbugs stod du 'tshangs nas rlung seng rnams na zhing 'phar ba dang*/ sha khol tser 'phrig pa sogs byung nas rlung rnal du ma phebs na/ sa khod snyoms pa'i steng du shing stum lag ngar tsam hril nar gyi steng du/ rkang pa'i rgyu ma khug khel bar byed pa'am/ shing phur khru gang pa gnyis kyi rtse mo sar btsugs pa'i bar du mkhyud gang tsam long pa'i shing phur gnyis kyi mgor rkang pa'i rgya khrag bkal te/ lag pa mdun du mkhar ba la brten ljid rkang pa la bkal ba'am/ yang na dbyug pa khru gsum tsam yod pa'i sne mo brang gi lhen snar btsugs te/ lus kyi ljid bkal zhing rlung bsdam/ lan lnga'am gsum la sogs pa bskyar bas rkang pa la drod phebs shing*/ bar rlung stod du 'tshangs pa'i gegs sel bar 'gyur ro// yang thur sel gyen du log pa zhes kyang zer/ las rlung drag tu gyen la log nas dbugs mi 'thon zhing*/ mgo bo dang rna 'gram ro stod rlung srang rnams na zhing*/ mig gyen du ldog /dbugs phyir du bskyel 'dren dka'/ lus kyi smad drod 'chor zhing*/ stod drod che bar 'bar/ mchan 'og dang skra mtshams nas rngul 'bab/ dri chen dang dri chu bsdams/ lce gre phugs su bros pa byung na myur du 'chos dgos te/

de las 'gyangs na tshe'i dus byed do// de'i gegs sel ba ni/ ska rags sam/ gru gu'am/ ras kyi pho rdo ji ltar 'tsham pa zhig de'i brang khugs su bcug la brdam/ rlung bzung nas grogs kyis khur ba'i sgal tshigs dang po nas/ mdzub bu chung gi bar khu tshur gyis dang po dal po dang*/ de nas drag tu rdung zhing 'phur ba grangs lnga'am bdun gyi bar byas pas rnal du phebs shing*/ de dag gi bar khur mi des kyang lus sprug cing bsig go /tshabs chung gong gi rtags 'then chung ba dang*/ dpung phrag g.yas g.yon dang yan lag bzhi'i mgul mtshams kyi rlung seng rnams la gnad du bsnun cing rtsa'i gnad mnyes pas gegs sel bar 'gyur ro// yang yan lag gi rlung log nas mig na zhing tsha ba dang*/ gangs kyis phyid pa lta bu dang mchi ma 'dzag cing*/ gang dang gang la'ang lta bar mi nus shing*/ mig 'bras na na lus kyi gnad bsgyur ba dang*/ lta stangs gzir ba las byung ba yin te/ lus gnad ni rgyab tu dbye bar byas la/ lag pa'i mkhur sha phan tshun mnye zhing shud pas drod phebs pa na mig la sbyar zhing 'phur la/ mig phug nas phyi ngos su cung zad 'phur zhing ltag pa'i bar rna gong nas shad cing 'phur ro// yang sna subs shing tsha ba dang sbrid pa klubs na/ rlung bzung bas sna'i krung mnyed cing*/ mgrin pa sgyed rlung 'bud pa mang bya'o// yang rlung bzung bas lce skrangs shing bsgyur mi shes pa lta bu dang/ lce'u chung babs na ha'i sgras kha nas phyir dbyung zhing lce gyen thur du sgril/ yang rna ba 'ur zhing na ba dang*/ gting nas gzer na rlung bcud cing*/ rna bar 'phur zhing mar byug par bya'o// yang rlung bzung bas so na zhing 'khrol te 'gul zhing 'phar na mar dkar bzhus pa'i nang du srin bal shing bu'i rtser bcings pa bcug pa'i drod dang bcas pa de nyid so mtshams su nems bya ba'am/ mar khu kha nang du bzung ngo*/ yang khyab byed log na/

gdong sbos shing kha sna 'tshubs lus byings la tsha lam dang*/ grang lhang*/ za 'phrug dang*/ sha ro/ bas ldag /zug med du skrangs pa sogs 'byung ste/ 'di yi gegs kyang*/ rlung log chen mo'i bcos ka dang*/ nyi ma dro ba la byug pa thems par bya zhing dbyi/ mi bskyod pa'i khrus byug gis kyang sel lo/ khyad par ngo gdong sbos pa la gan rkyal lus gnad dang ha 'don 'phur nyed kyis sel lo// yang des kyang ma sel na/ bya rog g.yam pa me la tshos par bsregs te zhib tu btags la mar nag rnying pa la btab byugs pas sel lo// yang rlung gi ya ma sbar te rtsa rgyud dang mgo gzhog khyad yod pa na ba dang*/ so dang 'gram pa na ba na/ rlung bsdams pa'i ljid ltag la bshud cing phur/ mar dkar byugs pas sel lo// yang lus stod smad gang du'ang gzer zug lhang lhang gang byung du/ lus srong zhing rlung bzung ba'i/ gang na sar rlung bcud cing drag tu phul la/ lag gis 'phur zhing bshud do// yang rlung bzung bas bad mkhris kyis nad bslangs nas/ pho ba'i stod smad du na zug che ba la rlung ma 'chun cing bshal skyug dka' bar 'phul sbyong gi spyi sman ni/ chu rtsa drod snum med pa dang*/ byang bul/ thar nu rnams cha snyoms la/ thur mgo gang tsam chu skol gyi lcag gis 'phul la btang*/ de rjes rlung zhi drag gang rung grangs mang bar bcug /gos kyis byibs pas/ sbyong 'byung ste/ chu skol 'thung ci thub yang yang btang la rlung mnan pas/ nad gang yang shang sgo las 'thon zhing*/ mthar chu mdog ma thon bar bshal 'byung ngo*// me drod gso ba la/ se 'bru/ sug smel/ shing tshwa/ pi pi ling bzhi cha snyoms pa la/ rgya tsha zhad tsam btang ba zhib tu btags la/ sna bus gang ba'i tshad chu grang gis phul la btang*/ thun grangs dang tshad sbyar ro// yang chu bsdams shing sri na/ lcam 'bru/ sdig srin/ drod sman/ pi pi ling bzhi cha snyoms la/ g.yer ma/ gze ma rnams cha snyoms/

rgya tshwa zhad tsam btab pa'i thang*/ dang po sla zhing bar du gar ba tha ma sla ba ci mang btang*/ bal 'dab gtsang ma la sngags 'di brgya stong bzlas pa la mchu sor sbyar/ oṃ chu shad shad dmar nar nar sa chal chal chu thon thon/ de nas nad las grol bar 'gyur ro// gzhan yang rlung gi nad phal che ba la rus gsar gyi thang sbyin/ mkhris pa la a ru ra gser mdog gi thang btang*/ bad kan skya smug gang la yang*/ tshwa la bul tog /cong zhi/ lga skya rnams cha snyoms la zhib tu btags la chu skol gyis phul zhing btang bas nad bshal du 'byung ngo*// sha dug dang sbyar dug sogs kyi nad bslangs pa la/ gtso bor rlung la 'bad cing*/ dri chu bskor bzlog steng 'og gis drangs pas nad byang zhing gso ba'i sman du 'gyur ro// sa bdag dang klu'i nad 'don na thog mar rlung la sbyang bar byas la/ gnyen po'i sman ni/ bse zho zho gang*/ thar nu zho phyed/ sman chen zho gang*/ a ru ra gser mdog zho bzhi/ gla rtsi zho lnga/ ra khrag nag po zho lnga rnams dang*/ pad+me dmar khra bar shog phral ba bcu gcig rgya tshwa zho phyed/ pi pi ling ma nyams pa rdog po gsum/ shing mngar sran ma tsam/ sdig srin thun bzang ba gsum gyi bungs/ lcam 'bru thun lnga/ gze ma thun lnga/ rma bya'i mdongs gsum/ rus sbal dang*/ pir gyi rus pa zho re/ de rnams zhal shes ltar zhib tu btags la/ tsan+dan mar khus mgo bsdus pa'i ril bu sran chung tsam re re nangs re bzhin bsten/ rlung la 'bad pas nad rnams rang sbyangs su 'byung zhing sos par 'gyur ro// 'dir ni rags pa'i nye bar mkho ba ci rigs su bris pa ste/ de las gzhan yang rig pa'i mda' yis bsnun par bya'o// 'di dag gong du dge slong gtsang pas zin bris su byas 'dug pa la gzhi byas shing*/ ma 'thus pa kha shas mtshams su babs par bsgrigs te/ lha btsun chos kyi rje'i bkas bskul ba la brten/ 'bri khung pa rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal pos bu tshal pho brang rtser bris pa 'dis kyang 'gro ba'i don du gyur cig// /
